items.te: Ohio Returns $15,300 Lost at Crypto ATM in Fake Microsoft Scam
items.se: An Ohio woman recovered her entire loss after a fake Microsoft support call directed her to send money through a crypto ATM. The case illustrates how computer warnings can become payment demands that move cash into fraudsters’ digital wallets. Fake Microsoft Hotline Led to a $15,300 Crypto Transfer
